{{Infobox place|name=The Bell of Silence|type=Seat of [[House Whitehart]]|region=[[the Light Heights]]|house=[[House Whitehart]]|notable=The griffes; the empty bell; listening rooms, not throne rooms}}
'''The Bell of Silence''' is the monastery-like seat of [[House Whitehart]], high in a mountain valley of [[the Light Heights]] where the echo carries. The dead rest in '''the griffes''' — open niches in the mountain wall facing the valley, so the voices carry. Its great bell has '''no clapper''' and never rings by human hand; the old ones swear it tolls in still air, and that this means a [[The Called|Called]] one has been born, or has died.

It is the only seat in the realm that does not defend against the unknown east. It turns toward it — open, listening.

''Not to be confused with the book: [[The Bell of Silence]].''
